title: DVT and PE: acute, chronic or history
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM code for the patient's deep vein thrombosis or pulmonary embolism (only that code).
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up for pulmonary embolism.

HPI
Pt is an 83 y.o. female presenting for f/u of acute pulmonary embolism diagnosed 2 weeks ago via CT imaging. Pt reports mild shortness of breath but denies chest pain or worsening dyspnea. Currently in first months of anticoagulant treatment. Tolerating medication well without significant side effects.

Medication List
Apixaban 5mg BID

Exam
Gen: Well-appearing, alert, in no acute distress.
CV: RRR, CTAB, no murmurs.
Resp: Clear to auscultation, no wheezes or crackles.
Musc: No calf tenderness.
Vitals: BP 128/78, HR 72, RR 16, SpO2 97% on RA.

Assessment
1. Acute pulmonary embolism. Stable on current anticoagulation.

Plan
1. Continue Apixaban as prescribed.
2. Continue monitoring for any new respiratory symptoms or signs of bleeding.
3. F/u in 4 weeks for routine check.

Electronically signed
P. O'Brien, PA-C
10/14/2026
explanations: Acute pulmonary embolism without acute cor pulmonale, under initial treatment: I26.99 (HCC 267).
